raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. ( liter. ) zero, angka kosong, sifar; 2. nonentity, (orang yg) tdk penting: he is a mere ~ in the organization, dia orang yg tdk penting dlm pertubuhan itu; 3. system of secret writing, tulisan rahsia; 4. ( rare ) see MONOGRAM; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : vt put ( st ) into cipher, menulis [sst] dlm tulisan rahsia: he ~ed the message, dia menulis mesej itu dlm tulisan rahsia. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
